name: Dry Creek rider
role: Gives the Dry Creek Outfit's work in person
about: Horse thieves and rustlers: easygoing, joking, never quite friendly. Talk money first.

say: Nice animal you rode in on.
Be a shame if it wandered off.
You got a lot of gall walking up to me.
Git, before I change my mind about shooting you.
Dry Creek don't do business with you no more.
You already got a job of ours.
Fella's been talking about us to the law.
One of the other outfits keeps a wagon out yonder.
I'd like to see it burn.
There's a horse I've had my eye on.
Bring it to us and there's money in it.
